headline: Saber denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator’s writers with ChatGPT
summary: Saber CEO Matthew Karch denies replacing writers with AI for 'Rideshare Stimulator'. Former lead writer Stella Sacco claims she was indeed replaced by ChatGPT. This fuels ongoing debate about AI in game development.

headline: Xbox Elite 3 prototype pad leaks with tiny built-in screen
summary: A Redditor posted photos of a legitimate-looking Xbox Elite Series 3 prototype controller. The leaked pad, reportedly bought for $200, features a unique tiny built-in screen. This follows earlier leaks from a Brazilian regulator.

headline: An FCC filing points to new Sonos headphones coming soon
summary: An FCC filing by Sonos Inc. reveals details about upcoming wireless headphones, model S52A. These are expected to be the successor to the Sonos Ace headphones. CEO Tom Conrad previously hinted at new headphones during an earnings call.

headline: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced Gemini has reached 1 billion monthly users, becoming Google's fastest-growing product. OpenAI's ChatGPT also recently crossed the 1 billion user milestone. This highlights the rapid, widespread adoption of major AI platforms.

headline: Zack Snyder Returns to Warner Bros. Lot Years After DCEU Exit
summary: Zack Snyder made a surprise return to the Warner Bros. lot. His visit years after his DCEU exit sparks significant speculation. Fans are wondering about his potential future projects with the studio.

headline: Save 50% Off the Ecoflow River 3 Plus Power Station, Now Just $139
summary: The Ecoflow River 3 Plus Power Station is now available for 50% off. Originally retailing for $280, it's currently priced at $139. This deal offers a significant discount on the Costco-exclusive power station.

headline: Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level Is Priced Under $30
summary: The Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level is on sale for under $30. It provides a modern, precise alternative to traditional bubble levels. This deal makes accurate leveling more accessible.

headline: JSAUX Screen Protector for Nintendo Switch 2 is Just $7
summary: A JSAUX screen protector for the Nintendo Switch 2 is available for only $7. This affordable pack includes three screen protectors. It offers cheap and effective insurance for your console's screen.

headline: Early release scheme risks more serious crimes, probation chief warns
summary: The chief inspector of probation warns an early release scheme could lead to more serious crimes. Probation services in England and Wales are under 'unprecedented pressure'. This raises concerns about public safety and system strain.

headline: Woman assaulted by double murderer claims police failures led to further attacks
summary: A woman assaulted by serial sex offender Simon Levy states police failures allowed him to re-offend. She claims a series of 'disastrous decisions' led to him being free. Levy later murdered two women and raped a third.

headline: UK to get best eclipse since 1999 as Moon blocks out Sun across Europe
summary: The UK is set to experience its most significant solar eclipse since 1999. Up to 96% of the Sun will be obscured by the Moon across Britain. Parts of Europe, including Spain and Iceland, will witness a total eclipse.

headline: Three ways to watch the solar eclipse safely without glasses
summary: With eclipse glasses possibly out of stock, alternative safe viewing methods are highlighted. You can safely observe the solar eclipse using simple household items. This guide provides practical options for those without specialized eyewear.
